notes: Estimates are incremental given parents already ran. Actual spend depends on history chunking and retries. Scope (Alpha/Spot gate) always runs first. Reply with n numbers, ids, or all.

modules.name: Who got tokens before listing
modules.plain: Finds the deployer and every wallet that received tokens before Binance Alpha listed this coin. Shows who still holds vs who already moved them.

modules.name: Top holders now
modules.plain: Snapshot of the biggest wallets right now, with exchange or project labels when known.

modules.name: Big transfers (last ~3 days)
modules.plain: Large token moves in the last few days, with transaction links. Best pick if you want tx hashes.

modules.name: Liquidity / how much you can buy
modules.plain: Main pool size and a rough 5% slippage cap, so you know how large a buy can be without moving the price much.

modules.name: CEX futures listing
modules.plain: Checks whether Binance, Aster, or Bitget already list a perpetual. Free — no Surf spend.

modules.name: When the pool started
modules.plain: First liquidity transfer vs Alpha listing time. Also runs #4.

modules.name: Who holds what role
modules.plain: Splits supply into pool, deployer, quiet insiders, dump destinations, and other. Also runs #1 and #2.

modules.name: Confirmed sells
modules.plain: How much insider supply actually sold on a DEX or went to an exchange deposit. Also runs #1.

modules.name: How big wallets got tokens
modules.plain: For large wallets: minted, bought on a DEX, or received from another wallet. Also runs #1 and #2.

modules.name: Who can mint
modules.plain: Wallets that received brand-new tokens from the zero address (bridges, staking, airdrops).

modules.name: High-volume dumpers
modules.plain: Wallets that took a large pile, sent almost all of it out, with lots of transactions.

modules.name: Exchange split to many wallets
modules.plain: Pattern: an exchange hot wallet sends to a hub that splits into many smaller wallets.

modules.name: Hidden wallet groups
modules.plain: Wallets that look separate but send to each other. Also runs #2.

modules.name: Last 3 days: spread vs dump-to-exchange
modules.plain: One wallet seeding many addresses, or many addresses sending into an exchange, last 3 days. Also runs #2.

modules.name: Fresh mints
modules.plain: Large new token creation by day (fresh supply).

modules.name: Watchlist export
modules.plain: Deduped wallet list from whatever you already ran. Free — no extra Surf spend.

modules.name: Wash trading (advanced)
modules.plain: Closed-loop wash detection. Expensive. Not available in this skill — use /hertzflow.

modules.name: Same whales on other tokens (advanced)
modules.plain: Same wallet in the top holders of many Alpha tokens. Often routers. Not available here — use /hertzflow.

modules.name: MEV / sandwich flow (advanced)
modules.plain: Sandwich / MEV-style flow operators. Not available here — use /hertzflow.
